numerical_translation_checks: Separate independent energy/force tests pass; they do not establish empirical parameter quality.

preregistered_validation.comparisons: Relative conformer energies and gradients; preserve failed calculations and separate bonded/nonbonded contributions.
preregistered_validation.cyclic_terms: Use ring-preserving conformers or constrained puckering; never rotate a ring bond as if it were an acyclic rotor.
preregistered_validation.production_sensitivity_execution: Any retained full binding calculation remains an explicitly registered on-chain protocol; no local calculation is substituted as its production result.
preregistered_validation.quantum_reference: Independent declared electronic-structure method/basis and constrained relaxed conformers; method is not yet selected or executed.
preregistered_validation.scope: Validate every high-analogy torsion family before accepting a production force-field model.
preregistered_validation.sensitivity: Predeclare half/double amplitudes for flagged Fourier components as exploratory sensitivity variants. These are not statistical error bars and do not substitute for quantum validation.

review_trigger: Native parmchk2 analogy score >100 triggers explicit review. This is a conservative workflow trigger, not a calibrated physical-error threshold.
